name: three_story_steel
reference_origin: Independent round-2 published-script runs; downloaded source bytes reverified.
notes: Original Pushover selection retained. Ten gravity plus 180 lateral analyze(1) calls returned zero. Plain and observed recorder outputs preserved.

The published script was rerun unchanged on 2026-10-06 in an external scratch folder. Read-only eleResponse observations after each original analyze(1) capture the fiber curve at full precision, replacing the six-significant-digit recorder output. All reference nodal scalars were rechecked.
